claims.claim_text: The classical three-disk physical flow, semiclassical periodic-orbit constructions, exact-quantum determinants, and classical transfer determinants are differently typed objects even when they share geometry and symbolic itineraries.

negative_constraints.rule: Do not substitute a semiclassical or exact-quantum determinant for the classical physical-flight-roof transfer determinant.

claims.claim_text: A pointwise physical roof and eligible transfer operator require one exact object map joining the collision section, coding, geometry evaluator, regularity, normalization, and function space.

negative_constraints.rule: Do not infer exact d=6a applicability from shared Axiom-A, Anosov, analytic-flow, or open-billiard terminology.
Do not construct a pointwise roof by fitting the inherited finite orbit totals.

claims.claim_text: Euler, periodic-trace, and Fredholm-determinant agreement is an internal roof-agnostic calibration identity for a consistently defined admissible roof and therefore is not evidence that the roof is physically correct.

negative_constraints.rule: Do not treat internal success or failure of unit, shuffled, or neighboring roofs as physical specificity evidence.

claims.claim_text: A lawful orbit-to-finite-rank coefficient map and a complete four-part error contract are distinct prerequisites; the corpus supports conditional tail, projection, and determinant-evaluation components but does not identify a dedicated roundoff source.

negative_constraints.rule: Do not infer a coefficient correspondence from a shared cutoff label.
Do not claim that the frozen corpus already supplies a roundoff theorem or a complete four-error bound.

claims.claim_text: Livsic-type periodic-data reasoning is asymmetric: after exact hypotheses are matched, a certified mismatch may obstruct one predeclared scale/coboundary relation, whereas finite agreement cannot prove global equivalence.

negative_constraints.rule: Do not report any project-specific nontransfer result or infer a positive cohomology conclusion from the finite owner panel.

claims.claim_text: Paper 30 has six, not five, object-specific downstream obligations: pointwise physical roof, operator eligibility, common coefficient map, four-part error contract, physical fidelity with typed controls, and theorem-licensed nontransfer.

negative_constraints.rule: Do not collapse or omit any of the six object-specific obligations.

claims.claim_text: The Phase-4 report is a literature-only evaluability program and reports no constructed roof, operator, determinant, coefficient comparison, error bound, fidelity result, or nontransfer certificate.

negative_constraints.rule: Type findings as evidence-synthesis findings and keep every scientific endpoint NOT_RUN or NOT_EVALUATED.
